notes: NJ savings bank, held by Investors Bancorp Inc. Counterparty on Jared 2018 (item 8) and Ivanka NE (item 8). Also named on Trump 2021 Termination as the creditor on the Trump Park Avenue LLC mortgage (item 5) — that row defers with the broader cp_filing_0003 deferral per Fork F §4 Decision Q1, but the entity is registered now for entity-reference integrity. Note: Investors Bancorp later acquired by Citizens Financial Group in 2018 (Investors Savings Bank brand retained for a period); canonical name reflects the entity at the time of disclosure.
